provenance.source: Yoshi Island Europe, private Mesen native sprite and VRAM captures
provenance.EUWRAMRelocation: USA boss globals+2; verified on exact ROM opcodes
provenance.pixelExtraction: Original generated4bpp OBJ tiles with exact CGRAM; transparent native color0; inactive OAM y>=224 omitted; no perframe rescaling. Each clip applies one constant first visible-foot correction. Death offsets remain relative a fixed encounter anchor.

moon.source: Mode7 VRAM map/pixels from idle-0/raw-40.bin; source palette indices0..10 connected moon component; no screenshot color key

limitations: Original native fight has three stakes/hits (HP mask7→3→1), not six. Six crossover damage levels alias the two actual native stake injuries and associated palette levels; no extra invented injury frames.
Moon orbit AI and camera are not emulated by these RGBA clips. Native death screen travel/rotation/scale is preserved; optional native moon texture provides original environmental context.

Final star and constellation are decoded from native Mode7 matrix projection and BG palette indices62/63. OBJ palette0 is PPU-masked at that point and deliberately omitted. Final sprite slot disappears at native frame781 (15.62 seconds).
Hurt replay enters verified original post-stake state with private WRAM writes; it does not replay a whole player-controlled stake collision.

moonCorrection.nativeMode: Mode7 VRAM tilemap even bytes, indexed character pixels odd bytes, original CGRAM colors
moonCorrection.oldDefect: Index<=10 mask removed original alternate moon/stake material indices33..59, producing rectangular holes at stake tiles; palette0 incorrectly retained though native transparent.
moonCorrection.alpha: Original native material support plus component membership; no RGB color keying, no filling, no invented pixels

uprightIdle.method: Original native idle pixels, Canvas orientation correction only; foot anchor from transformed alpha bounds. Injury and defeat sequences unchanged.
